description: Canonical Technique = verified method kernel. Content Item is a product expression. Canon: docs/practices/PRACTICE_TECHNIQUE_PROVENANCE_V1.md. Registry starts empty; LLM is not a technique source.

fields.type: taxonomy type code this kernel implements
fields.source_family: clinical_psychology | mindfulness_protocol | behavioral_science | official_health | academic_description | recognized_school | tradition_primary | historical_philosophical
fields.source_refs: list of {source, edition?, locus, paraphrase}; no copyrighted prose
fields.tradition: string list; intellectual lines, not an app brand
fields.evidence_level: existence of the method: unverified | tradition_attested | protocol_attested | academic_described | product_only
fields.efficacy_claim_level: right to claim effect: not_claimed | anecdote | single_study | review | guideline; default not_claimed
fields.canonical_mechanism: one sentence: what the method does
fields.canonical_steps: string list: stable kernel + safety-relevant bounds; not UI copy
fields.safety_notes: string list: product limits, not diagnoses
fields.prohibited_claims: string list; medical / guaranteed outcomes / manifestation at minimum
fields.review_status: empty | landscape | extracted | normalized | safety_reviewed | canonical | rejected

invariants: LLM is not the field source of mechanism or steps
review_status canonical required before item status active
